newsitem.title: USA: Weekly US energy data to be issued Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Weekly US energy data to be issued Thurs.

text.p: Weekly oil and natural gas stocks reports issued by the American Petroleum Institute, Energy Information Administration and American Gas Association for the week ending Dec. 27 will be delayed to Thursday, Jan. 2, because of the New Year holiday.
The API weekly petroleum stocks report will be issued Thursday after 1600 EST/2100 GMT, two days later than normal.
EIA said it would release its petroleum supply report Thursday at 1700 EST/2200 GMT, instead of Wednesday morning.
AGA said it would release its natural gas storage report Thursday after 1600 EST/2100 GMT, instead of the regular Wednesday.
